description: This source file defines multiple Grain classes implementing specific interfaces for Orleans framework testing. Each class contains methods for setting, incrementing, and retrieving internal state variables, along with some methods returning type names.

classes.name: DoSomethingEmptyGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing IDoSomethingEmptyGrain with methods to get its type name, set, increment, and get the value of A.

classes.name: DoSomethingEmptyWithMoreGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing IDoSomethingEmptyWithMoreGrain with methods to get its type name, set, increment, and get the value of A, and also a DoMore method.

classes.name: DoSomethingWithMoreGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing IDoSomethingWithMoreGrain with methods to get type name, set, increment, retrieve values of A and B, and methods to set, increment, and get these values.

classes.name: DoSomethingWithMoreEmptyGrain
classes.description: A Grain implementing IDoSomethingWithMoreEmptyGrain with methods similar to other grains involving A and a method DoMore.

classes.name: DoSomethingCombinedGrain
classes.description: A Grain implementing IDoSomethingCombinedGrain that manages three state variables A, B, and C, with methods to modify and retrieve each.

methods.name: DoIt
methods.description: Returns the type name of the Grain instance.

methods.name: DoMore
methods.description: Returns the type name, variously used in some grains as an additional method.

methods.name: DoThat
methods.description: Returns the type name; specific to some grains.
